summary: Docs-only authority audit of PR #520 (8 rows) with adversarial verification of findings

rows.evidence: The precedence order is the same in DOCUMENT_AUTHORITY_AND_SUPERSESSION.md §1, ADDENDUM §2, PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS lines 5-7, CLAUDE.md 'WE STAY FIT current authority' and the AGENTS.md WSF read list: newer Devin decision > v3.0 + v3.1 addendum > compact v3.1 instructions > accepted repo decisions > scoped milestone/journey records > historical. At head, CLAUDE.md line 73 marks WE_STAY_FIT_MASTER.md as 'Historical v1.2 only'. The old line calling it 'Master source of truth ... governs over' is gone at 54d3eaca, though it is still in the local working-tree CLAUDE.md because the checkout is not at head. WE_STAY_FIT_MASTER.md has a SUPERSEDED banner (lines 1-20). UNIVERSAL_COMMUNITIES_CHARTER.md has a 'Historical Foundation' banner (lines 1-8). The map §6 table classifies both. No agent-facing .claude/ file or skills/browser-use-e2e file mentions WSF (git grep, no hits). Gaps found: (a) Strategic Master v3.0 is named as GOVERNING #2 but is NOT in the tree. `git ls-tree -r 54d3eaca` has no v3.0 or 'Living WE System' document, and no changed doc says where it lives. (b) The map leaves out the new Implementation and Operations Charter v1. (c) The addendum's silence clause is garbled. (d) Unbanner'd docs/westayfit/EXPO_CRITICAL_PATH.md still says 'Governed by WE_STAY_FIT_MASTER.md'. (e) The v1.2 master body still carries its own §0/§11 self-authority text under the banner. (f) RISKS R-13 names an undefined 'Director' as retargeting authority.

CURRENT_STATE.md is now a 46-line pointer. It has no status ledger and points to the single #365 comment 'CANONICAL CURRENT STATE — EDIT THIS COMMENT IN PLACE' (issuecomment-5847443607). This matches ops/FABLE_OPERATING_PROTOCOL_v1.md §15 and DOCUMENT_AUTHORITY §4. RELEASES.md has a 'historical append-only' banner, and its only staging URL (westayfit-app--staging-x4m0iwln, expired 2026-09-03) sits inside a dated 2026-08-26 entry. MILESTONES §2 says the old PR/staging/email notes are superseded. EXPO_READINESS, the ops charter §12, PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS line 98 and addendum §2 all defer volatile state to #365. I grepped for URLs, SHAs, 'currently', 'today', 'live', 'deployed', 'served' and 'latest'. Every SHA is historical (092839b, 79df0d4). 'Currently targets westayfit-staging' in ARCHITECTURE/DEPENDENCIES matches skills/wsf-staging-deploy/SKILL.md. The Node 20 claim matches functions-westayfit/package.json engines.node '20'. The DATA_OWNERSHIP collection names were all found in functions-westayfit/firestore.rules at head. Exception: RISKS R-WSF-E1 states a volatile served-state fact ('CLOSED in served lineage' / 'present in the currently served product lineage') with no receipt, SHA or #365 pointer. There are also lower-severity present-tense leftovers in RISKS R-9 ('clear today') and MILESTONES ('In flight', 'E2 starts now'), listed under row 8.

Head files checked in full: ARCHITECTURE, CURRENT_STATE, DATA_OWNERSHIP, DEPENDENCIES, EXPO_READINESS, LOVABLE_HANDOFF, MILESTONES, RELEASES, RISKS, UNIVERSAL_COMMUNITIES_CHARTER, WE_STAY_FIT_MASTER (banner plus §0/§5/§9/§11), AGENTS (WSF section), CLAUDE (KB table plus WSF authority). DECISIONS was checked for the new 2026-09-26 entries plus grep. Clean: CURRENT_STATE, DATA_OWNERSHIP, DEPENDENCIES, EXPO_READINESS, LOVABLE_HANDOFF, RELEASES, UNIVERSAL_COMMUNITIES_CHARTER (except the MILESTONES reference below), the new DECISIONS entries, AGENTS, CLAUDE. Contradictions remain in ARCHITECTURE (unchanged context lines), MILESTONES, RISKS and the v1.2 MASTER body.

verdict.reason:
The quote appears word for word at line 71 of the head version of DOCUMENT_AUTHORITY_AND_SUPERSESSION.md, in the "6. Document status" table. That table has eleven rows and none of them is WE_STAY_FIT_IMPLEMENTATION_OPERATIONS_CHARTER_v1_2026-09-26.md, even though this PR adds that file. - DECISIONS.md (around line 492) says "the September 26 Implementation and Operations Charter replaces its sequencing/status role."

The map's intro says it answers "when WSF documents disagree, which one should an agent trust?" Its section 8 says "update this map when a document's standing changes." A fresh agent using the map would see the v0.2 plan marked SUPERSEDED but would not be told what replaced it. The map lists FABLE_OPERATING_PROTOCOL_v1.md as "GOVERNING current coordination/evidence discipline". The charter claims evidence discipline too, and nothing ranks the two against each other.

Nothing near the row qualifies it or points to the replacement. The head versions of CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, WE_STAY_FIT_MASTER.md and FABLE_OPERATING_PROTOCOL_v1.md do not mention the charter either.

findings.heading: (preamble, before §1)
findings.quote: When this addendum and v3.0 are silent, v3.0 governs.
findings.governing: Same paragraph and DOCUMENT_AUTHORITY §1: the addendum governs newer decisions and v3.0 is the foundation. The sentence as written is self-contradictory, since v3.0 cannot govern where v3.0 is silent.
findings.correction: Change it to 'Where this addendum is silent, v3.0 governs.'

verdict.reason: The quote is verbatim at line 8 of the head addendum, in the preamble just before "## 1. Why this addendum exists": "When this addendum and v3.0 are silent, v3.0 governs." Nothing near it qualifies it. The next sentence ("Devin's newer explicit decision still governs its stated scope.") does not fix the logic. The defect is inside the sentence itself: if v3.0 is silent on a point, v3.0 cannot govern that point. The intended rule ("where the addendum is silent, v3.0 governs") can be recovered from the sentence before it ("This addendum governs only the newer decisions..."), from DOCUMENT_AUTHORITY_AND_SUPERSESSION.md §1 item 2 and from Project Instructions v3.1 line 5 ("v3.0 ... plus the ... v3.1 addendum as the governing product strategy"). None of those sources says anything about silence, so they do not contradict the sentence outright. The candidate overstates it slightly by calling DOCUMENT_AUTHORITY §1 a conflicting source; it only confirms the intended layering. Impact is low. A fresh agent would still end up with v3.0 as the foundation, so the sentence does not steer anyone toward stale older masters. It is still a garbled precedence rule in authority text, which is more than a style nit, so I am keeping it as a real finding at low severity.
verdict.betterCorrection: Replace it with: "Where this addendum is silent, v3.0 governs. Where both are silent, fall through to the authority order in §2 and DOCUMENT_AUTHORITY_AND_SUPERSESSION.md §1."

verdict.reason: This is a real finding, but a low-severity one. (a) The quote appears word for word at line 10 of `docs/westayfit/EXPO_CRITICAL_PATH.md` at 54d3eaca, in the preamble just above "## 1. The real deadline is not October 11". The PR does not touch this file; its last change was 38fea68f. (b) The conflict is real. At head, `DOCUMENT_AUTHORITY_AND_SUPERSESSION.md` §6 "Document status" lists "docs/westayfit/WE_STAY_FIT_MASTER.md v1.2 (2026-09-06) | SUPERSEDED product master; retained historical architecture lineage". §1 puts v3.0 + v3.1 addendum + Project Instructions v3.1 above "Older masters, handoffs ... only as historical/advisory material". Running `git grep EXPO_CRITICAL_PATH` at head finds only the file itself: the §6 map does not list it, and no WSF doc, AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md points to it. verdict.reason: The quote is in HEAD docs/westayfit/RISKS.md under R-13 (lines 162-163, split by a line break): "A newer project head does not retarget work without an explicit Director decision and manifest update." It does not conflict with DOCUMENT_AUTHORITY_AND_SUPERSESSION.md §2. verdict.reason: This finding holds up. (a) The quote appears word for word as line 107 of head docs/westayfit/RISKS.md, under the heading "## R-WSF-E1 — goal-read authorization (CLOSED in served lineage; retain as regression risk)". PR #520 added the sentence. At base the heading read "OPEN — source implementation pending acceptance and hosted verification". (b) It conflicts with the head governing sources. DOCUMENT_AUTHORITY_AND_SUPERSESSION.md line 40, "### Served staging", says: "Use the served build marker and deployment receipt. A branch head, pin, merge, build, or HTTP 200 is not enough." Line 47 says volatile program state lives only in the canonical CURRENT STATE comment on #365. CURRENT_STATE.md line 25 says: "Do not create a second mutable status ledger here." Its step 5 requires checking the served build marker or deployment receipt before any staging claim. Both the heading and the sentence assert current served state as a fact. They name no receipt, run, SHA, build marker or date. (c) Nothing nearby qualifies the claim. R-WSF-E1 has no such anchor, so a fresh agent could take "currently served" as a standing, current capability claim. The only mitigating factor is that the entry frames what remains as a regression risk, which is why I rate this medium rather than high.
verdict.betterCorrection: Change the sentence (and the matching phrase in the heading) to: "the shared access evaluator) was present in the served staging build recorded by the Package E hosted-verification deployment receipt <run/SHA, date>; confirm the current served lineage against the #365 CURRENT STATE record and the served build marker before relying on it."

findings.governing: The old direct commands this clarification is meant to demote (line 27 `firebase hosting:channel:deploy staging --config firebase.westayfit.json` and line 36) are ABOVE this section, inside Permanent Invariants (b)/(c). The only thing 'below' is the new Deploy Boundary Summary. skills/wsf-staging-deploy/SKILL.md says the staging site is `westayfit-staging`, not `westayfit-app`.
findings.correction: Change 'below' to 'above (invariants (a)-(c))' and mark the line-27 channel-deploy command as historical M-U1 procedure.

verdict.reason: (a) The quote is in head docs/westayfit/ARCHITECTURE.md at lines 90-91, under "## Environment clarification — September 26, 2026" (line 88). A markdown soft wrap splits it after "boundaries," so a single-line grep only matches the first half, but the text and the rendered sentence are identical. (b) The direction is wrong. Everything the clarification is meant to demote sits ABOVE line 88: the M-U1 invariants (a)-(h) at lines 7-86, including line 27 ("`firebase hosting:channel:deploy staging --config firebase.westayfit.json` deploys only the WSF site") and the direct `firebase deploy --only functions:westayfit` command in (c) at line 36. The only sections below it are the new Deploy Boundary Summary, the protected-resource contract and the authority note, and none of them contain an old direct Firebase command. The base had a second copy of the stale command in the old summary table (base line 92); the PR removed it, which leaves "below" pointing at nothing. The same wrong direction appears again at line 97: "Do not manually substitute the old direct Firebase commands below". (c) Nothing near line 27 or invariant (b) qualifies the command. Invariant (b) still says "WSF ships to Hosting site `westayfit-app`" and gives the channel-deploy command as how to deploy. The effect is real but moderate: the Deploy Boundary Summary and the authority note both send readers to the skill, which lowers the risk.
verdict.betterCorrection: In lines 90 and 97, change "below" to "above (Permanent Invariants (a)-(h), notably the commands in (b) and (c))", and add a note at line 27 marking that `hosting:channel:deploy` command as historical M-U1 procedure: current staging uses `westayfit-staging` only via skills/wsf-staging-deploy/SKILL.md.

The PR edited ARCHITECTURE.md but did not change this line, so the stale sentence is still in the reconciled file. (b) It conflicts with the head sources. So a single-line grep of the quote fails, although the rendered markdown matches. The same sentence is at base line 62, so this PR did not add it. It was carried over unchanged. Approved by Devin 2026-09-05; reconciled September 26, 2026.", says the file "preserves milestone identifiers and historical delivery intent. It is not the volatile current-state ledger".
